title: observability: token-kv logging + metrics + dashboards + alert tuning
author: Maya Patel
body: Summary: Add end-to-end token-level KV cache observability (logging + metrics + tracing), new Grafana dashboards for KV hit/miss/cost breakdowns, and tuned alerting thresholds to reduce noisy SRE pages. Motivation: customers running high-request-rate workloads were hitting unexpected KV cache behavior leading to cost spikes and tail-latency regressions. We lacked signal tying KV cache behavior to token-level cost/latency and to rollout changes (quantization/model variants). This PR introduces instrumentation, dashboarding, and alert tuning to make regressions visible and actionable. Changes: 1) Add structured token-KV logs emitted from serving runtime with stable keys (request_id, model, deploy_tag, kv_key_type, cache_outcome, latency_ms, token_count, cost_estimate_usd). Logs are JSON-lines and routed to the observability pipeline. 2) Add Prometheus metrics (redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_misses_total, redwood_kv_cache_evictions_total, redwood_kv_cache_latency_seconds_bucket, redwood_kv_cost_per_token_sum/count) with labels for model, region, deploy_tag, and shard. 3) Add tracing spans around KV lookup/insert with attributes for token_counts and cost_estimate to enable distributed traces tied to requests. 4) New Grafana dashboards: "KV Cache — Token-level Cost & Latency", "KV Cache — Regional Health", and "KV Cache — Model Rollout Correlation". Dashboards include: cost-per-token heatmaps, 99p tail latency by model and shard, rolling 5m KV hit rate, and a correlation panel showing deploy_tag rollouts vs cost delta. 5) Alert tuning: introduce composite alerts that combine sustained drop in hit_rate with >20% increase in cost_per_token or >30ms tail latency regression to avoid noisy pages for transient blips. 6) Update ingestion pipeline to add a lightweight JSON schema validator for token-level logs and add sampling config for high-volume models. 7) Add unit + integration tests for metric naming, label cardinality limits, dashboard JSON, and schema validation. Implementation notes: - All new metrics use the "redwood_" prefix and follow existing label cardinality limits; we capped per-model sample labels to avoid high cardinality. - Logs are emitted only when KV module is enabled to avoid extra overhead for customers not using KV. - Sampling defaults: 1% global, 100% for new deploy_tag for first 10 minutes to capture rollout behavior. Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout to 10% of traffic for two weeks, monitor dashboards and alert noise. If clean, progressively enable for all traffic. Checklist: - [x] Add structured logs from runtime - [x] Expose Prometheus metrics and histograms - [x] Create Grafana JSON dashboards - [x] Implement tracing spans and propagate attributes - [x] Add alert rules and reduce noisy triggers - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Documentation updates (docs/observability/kv-cache.md) Testing/validation: Local unit tests, CI integration tests (prometheus metrics parsing + dashboard lint), staging rollout with feature flag (observability.kv_token.enabled -> 10%). Observability SRE validated dashboards in staging and we ran a synthetic workload (10k rps) to verify sampling and cardinality. Related work: Linked Linear items ENG-8421 (KV caching improvements), SRE-184 (alert fatigue reduction), ENG-8002 (cost monitoring). Jira: SUP-1192 used during internal incident investigation. Notes for reviewers: focus on metric label choices and cardinality safeguards, alert expressions, and dashboard layout. If approved, will follow squash-merge and coordinated rollout with SRE.

review_comments: Liam O'Connor (2026-02-16): Please justify label sets - model+deploy_tag can cause cardinality explosion. Consider hashing deploy_tag or sampling.
Maya Patel (2026-02-16): Acknowledged. Added cardinality cap and hashing for deploy_tag; default sampling lowered to 1% and 100% for new deploys (first 10m).
Noah Kim (2026-02-18): Alert expressions LGTM but suggest composite rule to silence short spikes - added a 5m sustained window, see observability/alerts/kv_cache_rules.yaml.
Sofia Ramirez (2026-02-19): Minor nit: rename 'cost_per_token' -> 'kv_cost_per_token' to avoid collisions with other cost metrics. Updated across code and dashboards.
Carlos Mendez (SRE) (2026-02-20): Verified dashboards in staging; initial noise is low. Recommend gradual rollout and monitor 'pager_count' metric.
merge_commit: h8d1e2f: squash merge - observability: token-kv logging + metrics + dashboards + alert tuning
release_notes: Added token-level KV cache observability: structured logs, Prometheus metrics, tracing spans, Grafana dashboards, and tuned alerts to reduce noisy pages. Rollout is feature-flagged and staged.
